title: Local Area Marketing Agency Melbourne - nimbl

facts.fact: nimbl's own case study reports a 48% increase in traffic from a Sydney launch for a client using Conversion Rate Optimisation, Digital Advertising, Google Ads and Social Ads.
facts.quote: +48% increase in traffic from Sydney launch

facts.fact: nimbl's own case study reports a 57% reduction in intro offer acquisition cost for a client using Digital Advertising, Lead Generation and Social Ads.
A testimonial from One Hot Yoga & Pilates says 700 bookings were made out of an available 900 as classes were added, with many classes waitlisted.
facts.quote: 700 bookings of an available 900 (as we have added more classes) with many classes waitlisted.

facts.fact: A client testimonial says nimbl's results have been positive over the past 2 years of working together.
facts.quote: for the past 2 years our results have been extremely positive

facts.fact: nimbl offers a free digital audit or free website analysis to prospective clients.
facts.quote: Ask us for a free digital audit!

facts.fact: nimbl describes itself as a boutique, Melbourne-based digital agency whose team is all located under one roof in Melbourne, while working with businesses across Australia and abroad.
facts.quote: nimbl is a boutique, Melbourne-based digital agency

facts.fact: nimbl says it prioritises a smaller selection of clients so it can build long-term growth and relationships.
facts.quote: We prioritise having a smaller selection of clients

facts.fact: nimbl's SEO service includes local SEO, with its strategies emphasising Google My Business for brick-and-mortar businesses.
facts.quote: Our search engine optimisation strategies emphasises Google My Business

facts.fact: nimbl's local intent campaigns prioritise location-intent search queries, which it says have a higher chance of driving customers to a business.
facts.quote: We ensure that our search based campaigns prioritise location intent queries

facts.fact: nimbl's campaigns for local businesses focus on conversion points such as store visits or direction requests.
facts.quote: such as store visits or direction requests

facts.fact: nimbl's local services include retargeting on social media to promote special offers and business updates to an established customer base.
facts.quote: social media retargeting to promote special offers, specials, and the latest business updates
